E1.evidence: The issue reacts to a documentation change (the rolling pluginlib tutorial no longer mentions the `name` attribute) and proposes a deprecation layer in controller_manager for `/`-separated plugin names; no failed interaction, reproducer, or error log is reported. The reporter (a ros2_control maintainer) withdrew it the same day: "I think this was false alarm:" followed by a link to pluginlib class_loader_imp.hpp L700-L712 (https://github.com/ros-controls/ros2_control/issues/2461#issuecomment-3185924155), i.e. pluginlib still supports the `name` attribute. The fix refs are documentation-only PRs (ros2_documentation #5835 on rolling and backports #5836 humble, #5837 jazzy, #5838 kilted, "Describe magic name attribute for pluginlib XML") that edit source/Tutorials/Beginner-Client-Libraries/Pluginlib.rst to document ``name`` (optional): "A lookup name (i.e. magic name) used by the class loader." No code or interface of any unit changed.
